ROvis (development version)

ROvis 0.1.0

First release since the original ROvis monolith was split into this umbrella package plus six standalone packages (ROvis.utils, ROvis.ggplot2, ROvis.plotly, ROvis.echarts, ROvis.table, ROvis.shiny), and the repository moved from GitLab to GitHub.
